interface.longDescription: Mercury Finance connects Codex to one hosted MCP for cited accounting knowledge, connector discovery, workspace readiness, and reusable finance workflows. Install once with no local server, Python runtime, Supabase key, or Mercury token. Mercury Tools is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with Mercury Technologies, Inc.
